This row closes when either the cause is identified or a clean unbroken 72h run exists -- not when the remaining 35h finish

summary: The soak QEMU regression sweep runs without --serial-capture, so when checkpoint 10 recorded a priority-inversion FAIL (LE-45) NO diagnostic existed for the one run that mattered, and 26 clean re-runs cannot recover what the failing instance would have printed. An unreproducible failure with no capture is indistinguishable from an environmental artifact and from a real intermittent scheduler defect, and the soak exists precisely to catch the latter. The sweep is armed to DETECT but not to EXPLAIN, which is the same shape as LE-29 declared-but-never-exercised one level along: the instrument fires and leaves no trace
owner_path: Run the soak sweep with --serial-capture per fixture, or at minimum retain a capture for any non-zero exit and re-run under capture before the checkpoint is written. Cheap: the flag already exists and CI already uses it for broken-boot and idt-apic-unrouted. Until then any future PERF-D07-G22 closure is exposed to the same objection, because an anomaly with no capture cannot be adjudicated either way
